name: village-hall-b
description: Village Hall, Version B (the Moot House), rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/village_hall.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: for L in 1 2 3; do ID=village_hall; [ $L = 1 ] || ID=village_hall_$L; LEVEL=$L node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py village_hall_b $ID --candidate --nbt out/$(echo $ID | tr _ -).nbt || exit 1; done
